Name: Rabbit Clover of Better Artisan Goods
Author: ChaBeR39
Description:
[b][size=5]Original assets: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url][/size]
[/b]
[size=1]First of all, I salute my English skills. I am Korean.[/size]

The idea of turning a rabbit foot in Better Artisan Goods mode into a four-leaf clover was great! I made a CP mode that separated it from Better Artisan Goods mode. Image and English are Better Artisan Goods mode assets.
[size=3]
[b]If you use it with Better Artisan Goods mode, you must modify 'rabbitFoot' to 'false' in the config file in Better Artisan Goods mode.[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]
Better Artisan Goods 모드와 함께 사용하신다면 Better Artisan Goods 모드의 config 파일에서 'rabbitFoot'을 'false'으로 수정해야 합니다.[/b][/size]

Downloads.Description:
Change the 'rabbit foot' to 'four-leaf clover'.
English and Korean.
